_source: 06 sections 2 (Combat Setup) and 3 (Round Order), with the row capacity of section 13 and the surprise die of 01 section 12. Later sections of 06 add their own tables to this file.

surprise._source: 06 section 2 step 3 and 01 section 12. Each side rolls a d6; a side that rolls inside its band surprises the other. Only one side surprised means a round 0 in which only that side acts.

initiative._source: 06 section 3, Initiative. Rolled fresh every round; monsters of the same type share one roll.
initiative._bands: first = under Quicksilver; last = Slowed, plus the Zombie, which always acts last. Both are flags on the unit (actsFirst / actsLast), so a potion, a condition and a monster's own tactics all reach the same band.

roundStartOrder._source: 06 section 3 steps 3-5, which is a finer order than the example column of section 16.

reactionFlags._source: 06 section 3 step 2. Reset at the start of every round, for any unit that has them.
